tagline: International association representing inland shipping, insurance and ship survey interests in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: The IVR organizes a major annual congress bringing together stakeholders from the European inland navigation sector. The 2024 congress in Frankfurt welcomed 225 participants from 11 countries, reflecting the association's central role in institutional representation and sectoral coordination.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the annual IVR congress.
kpis.description: Key indicator of IVR's influence and ability to mobilize stakeholders in the European inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Association's engagement and reach among stakeholders.

kpis.name: Countries Represented at Congress
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented at the annual congress.
kpis.description: Measures the geographic reach and cross-border influence of IVR.
kpis.signal: Pan-European geographic footprint of the association.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.description: First edition of the colloquium dedicated to technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: New event program to strengthen sectoral technical expertise.

kpis.description: IVR successfully organized its inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, gathering 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.

The annual IVR Congress held in Frankfurt am Main from May 15-17, 2024 welcomed 225 participants from 11 countries, maintaining the association's role as the central platform for European inland shipping stakeholder collaboration.
